name: Ácsteszér (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of blue and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Ácsteszér (a green shield with a red and white checky chief, a white fleur-de-lis and crossed tools, within a green wreath) above a yellow scroll inscribed ÁCSTESZÉR.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Ácsteszér arms with wreath and scroll
